top_signals.title: Colombia Inflation Unexpectedly Slows, Easing Pressure on Rates
top_signals.summary: Colombia’s inflation rate cooled last month, offering some relief to the central bank after policymakers recently surprised investors by keeping borrowing costs unchanged.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
